Regulatory and distribution shifts in Indonesia are creating winners among agile, digitally-native players (AGAR, VISI) while legacy conglomerates lose share, a durable structural trend.
sectors.ai: Consumer & FMCG is in a WATCH phase with aggregate -0.80%, but the sharp divergence between ID (-1.04%) and US (-0.33%) signals local idiosyncratic stress. Rotate into high-momentum names (BIKE, POLU, AGAR) that are delivering outsized gains, but trim exposure to laggards as domestic demand softens. Prioritize exporters and niche players with pricing power over broad-market staples.
